unit.title: The basic stitches and what each is for
unit.needIt: Three or four hand stitches are enough to mend a seam, fix a hem or fit a garment. Knowing which does what saves a trip to the tailor.
unit.why: Many people think sewing is a secret talent. This lesson shows that neat sewing is just the result of steady practice. It turns a hard task into a step by step skill.
unit.outcome: Identify and use different types of stitches and seams to build a garment.
unit.reachesYou: You see these stitches every time you check the inside of your favorite shirt. You also see them when you shop for clothes and look for quality seams.
unit.do: Find a piece of fabric and practice a simple running stitch to feel how the needle moves.

quiz.why: The text says bastings are temporary stitches to hold fabric until finishing stitches are made.
quiz.quote: Bastings are temporary stitches put in to hold the fabric together until the finishing stitches can be made.

quiz.q: What happens if you skip basting and use pins or machine sewing instead?
choices: It results in loss of time
It makes the garment look better
quiz.why: The text explains that skipping basting leads to a loss of time in the end.
quiz.quote: This always results in loss of time in the end and invariably proves that ''haste makes waste."

quiz.q: Which stitch is used when basting cloth onto lining or canvass?
quiz.why: The text specifies diagonal basting for lining or canvass.
quiz.quote: Diagonal basting is always used when basting cloth on to the lining or canvass.

quiz.why: Running stitches are defined by having equal lengths for stitches and spaces.
quiz.quote: Running stitches are a succession of small stitches, the stitches and spaces in between being of equal length.

quiz.q: When should you use a slip stitch?
quiz.why: The slip stitch is specifically for making stitches invisible, like on a hem.
quiz.quote: The slip stitch is used when hemming or sewing on facing or at any other part of the garment where stitches are to be made invisible.

quiz.q: How should you handle the thread when making a chain stitch?
choices: Do not pull the thread tight
quiz.why: Pulling the thread too tight prevents the chain from having a nice appearance.
quiz.quote: Do not pull the thread tight as it will not make a nice looking chain if you do.

quiz.q: What is a French seam used for?
quiz.why: French seams hide raw edges, which is necessary for thin or see-through fabrics.
quiz.quote: French seams are used when making garments out of any sheer material such as crepes or voiles

partials: Tailor tacks mark both sides of cloth.
Back stitches make seams firm and strong.
crystal.key: Different stitches serve specific purposes like holding, marking, or finishing.

decoys.text: Bastings are the final stitches on a garment.
decoys.why: The text says they are temporary stitches used until finishing stitches are made.

decoys.text: Running stitches are used to make seams invisible.
decoys.why: The text says slip stitches are used to make stitches invisible.

crystal.aha: Each stitch has a specific job to ensure the garment is accurate and well finished.

beats.say: Tape holds the shelf while you look.
A pencil mark shows where it goes.
Some stitches hold for now, some mark, some stay for good.
